display_title: Can a Snake and a Rabbit Marry?
description:
Ji-woo, a sweet rabbit, goes on a blind date with Inseong, a snake, by recommendation of her parents. When she opens her eyes after getting drunk, what she sees in front of her is Inseong's XX? 

But not one, but two? 

«You…why two?» 

«Jiwoo, snakes have two XX.» 

«What?!» 

One is too much, but two? I think I'll never get married!
